blocks.en: 684 entries in our Electronic Lab Notebook record the experiments, setbacks, and progress that shaped ReLEAF over 7 months of work.
blocks.text: 684 entries in our Electronic Lab Notebook record the experiments, setbacks, and progress that shaped ReLEAF over 7 months of work.
blocks.zh: 電子實驗紀錄簿中的 684 筆紀錄，記下了七個月來形塑 ReLEAF 的實驗、挫折與進展。

blocks.en: ReLEAF was shaped not only by successful results, but also by the experiments, setbacks, and revisions that came before them. This notebook covers cloning, transformation, plant experiments, hydroponics optimization, and bioreactor testing. Each entry was recorded as the work happened and follows the same structure: date, title, purpose, procedure, result, operator, and recorder. Failed experiments and repeated trials were kept alongside successful results to preserve the full experimental record. The notebook is organized by month, with a separate plant notebook documenting the development of our plant work.

blocks.zh: 形塑 ReLEAF 的不只是成功的結果，還有在那之前的實驗、挫折與修正。這本紀錄簿涵蓋選殖、轉形、植物實驗、水耕最佳化與生物反應器測試。每一筆紀錄都在工作當下寫下，並依同一個結構書寫：日期、標題、目的、步驟、結果、操作者與記錄者。失敗的實驗與重複的試驗都與成功的結果一併保留，以維持完整的實驗紀錄。紀錄簿依月份編排，另有一本植物紀錄簿記載植物工作的發展。

blocks.en: The season started with rigorous team safety training, the set-up of protocols for basic experiments, and early dry lab modeling, alongside human practices outreach with experts and schools.

blocks.en: As our protein and peptide designs matured, we moved into molecular cloning, including Golden Gate Assembly and colony PCR. Alongside it we established our Arabidopsis plant-stress set-ups and started the hydroponic and bioreactor pilot runs.

核心執行與回饋整合

blocks.en: The summer was our peak of operation and experimental progress. Wet lab cloning, bioreactor runs with Bacillus subtilis, plant salinity and heat stress assays, and protein expression and purification ran in parallel, and continuous measurement was tightly coupled with vigorous human practices engagement.

blocks.zh: 夏天是我們運轉與實驗進展的高峰。濕實驗選殖、以枯草桿菌進行的生物反應器運轉、植物鹽逆境與熱逆境檢測，以及蛋白質表現與純化同時並行，而持續的量測也與密集的人文實踐緊密扣在一起。

blocks.en: Each file below is the team's own export, including gene circuit construct results, plant protection outcomes and electrophoresis gel results. The lab notes were recorded daily without post-processing, so all original entries, such as failed runs and repeated gels, are still included. The blank pages the export put between one day and the next, and the pages that are not records — the reference format template and a copy-editing checklist — were taken out of the files; no entry was changed.

植物紀錄簿

blocks.en: Unlike the day-by-day record of the wet lab notebook, a complete plant experiment unfolds over days and sometimes weeks, and its critical milestones, from seed vernalization and transfer to protectant application and harvest, are spread across the calendar. To keep every experimental trial as one continuous record, our plant notebook unifies each experimental set from start to finish and tracks all of its growth timeline results. Full protocols and complete outcomes are on our Experiments and Plants pages.
blocks.text: Unlike the day-by-day record of the wet lab notebook, a complete plant experiment unfolds over days and sometimes weeks, and its critical milestones, from seed vernalization and transfer to protectant application and harvest, are spread across the calendar. To keep every experimental trial as one continuous record, our plant notebook unifies each experimental set from start to finish and tracks all of its growth timeline results. Full protocols and complete outcomes are on our Experiments and Plants pages.
blocks.zh: 與濕實驗紀錄簿逐日記錄的方式不同，一次完整的植物實驗會橫跨數天、有時數週，而它的關鍵節點——從種子春化、移植，到施用保護劑與採收——散落在行事曆各處。為了讓每一次試驗都成為一份連貫的紀錄，我們的植物紀錄簿把每一組實驗從頭到尾整合起來，追蹤它整段生長時間軸的結果。完整的操作流程與結果見實驗流程與植物試驗頁面。
